title: Bound of a linear inequality
source: Theory IGCSE-14.2 Quick check 1 (4x-7<=13 gives x<=5); book Worked example 10 style pp.442-443, new numbers
stem: Solve \({a|int}x-{b|int}\leqslant {C|int}\). The solution is \(x\leqslant k\). What is the value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.note: Adding b to both sides leaves a x <= a r.

contexts.note: Includes the original a=4, r=5, b=7, C=13

title: Largest integer in a half-open interval
source: Theory IGCSE-14.2 Quick check 2 (largest integer with 2<x<=7 is 7); book Worked example 9(b) style p.441, new numbers
stem: What is the largest integer \(x\) that satisfies \({p|int}<x\leqslant {q|int}\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: The right-hand end-point is included, so the largest integer is \({q|int}\).
steps.note: p and q are integers and p < x <= q, so the largest integer is q.

title: Reversing the inequality
source: Theory IGCSE-14.2 Quick check 3 (5-2x>11 gives x<-3); book warning pp.443-444, new numbers
stem: Solve \({s|int}-{t|int}x>{U|int}\). The solution is \(x<k\). What is the value of \(k\)?

steps.name: A
steps.text_tex: \(-{t|int}x>{U|int}-{s|int}\). Dividing by the negative coefficient reverses the inequality, so \(x<{r|int}\) and \(k={r|int}\).
steps.note: U = s - t r, so the critical value is r. The derived key is U.

contexts.note: Includes the original s=5, t=2, r=-3, U=11

title: Solve a linear inequality

source.note: Stem taken from the QP PDF (UCLES 2020), Question 4(a) only. Official answer and mark allocation from the MS PDF. The item is paper/self-mark. Parts (b) and (c) are omitted: they are an equation and a pair of simultaneous equations, outside this section.

stem:
This question is 0580/43/M/J/20 Question 4(a), taken from the official QP.

Solve the inequality.

\(3m+12\leqslant 8m-5\)  [2]

steps.name: M
steps.note: MS: M1 for 12+5 <= 8m-3m or better, or for 3m-8m <= -5-12 or better.

steps.name: A
steps.note: MS: m >= 3.4 oe final answer. Independent check: 3m+12 = 8m-5 gives 17=5m, so m=17/5=3.4, and the inequality direction is m greater than or equal to this value.
